_note: Each scene is one visual. 'say' is what the voice reads (spelled for TTS); 'show' is the on-screen caption. Facts come from src/lib/content/guides.ts (biology, locations, run-timing, tactics).

lines.say: Every fall, a river of silver moves down Florida's Atlantic coast.
lines.show: Every fall, a river of silver moves down Florida's Atlantic coast.

lines.say: Anglers call it the mullet run.
lines.show: Anglers call it the mullet run.

lines.say: Here's how it works, from Northeast Florida all the way to Miami.
lines.show: Here's how it works, from Northeast Florida all the way to Miami.

lines.say: The main event is the striped mullet, joined by silver and fantail mullet.
lines.show: The main event is the striped mullet, joined by silver and fantail mullet.

lines.say: They spend the summer in rivers, tidal creeks, and brackish estuaries, grazing on algae and detritus.
lines.show: They spend the summer in rivers, tidal creeks, and brackish estuaries, grazing on algae and detritus.

lines.say: As summer ends, the water cools.
lines.show: As summer ends, the water cools.

lines.say: When nearshore temperatures drop toward about sixty-eight degrees, mullet bunch up and head for the ocean.
lines.show: When nearshore temperatures drop toward about 68°F, mullet bunch up and head for the ocean.

lines.say: The first cold fronts dial it up.
lines.show: The first cold fronts dial it up.

lines.say: Falling pressure and a north or northeast wind push the biggest pods tight against the beach.
lines.show: Falling pressure and a north or northeast wind push the biggest pods tight against the beach.

lines.say: Then the run turns south.
lines.show: Then the run turns south.

lines.say: Northeast Florida sees it first.
lines.show: Northeast Florida sees it first.

lines.say: At Mayport, Jacksonville Beach, and Mickler's Landing, the core window runs from about September twenty-fifth to October twentieth.
lines.show: At Mayport, Jacksonville Beach and Mickler's Landing, the core window runs from about Sept. 25 to Oct. 20.

lines.say: From there, the schools work down the surf zone, past one inlet after another.
lines.show: From there, the schools work down the surf zone, past one inlet after another.

lines.say: Ponce Inlet. Cocoa Beach. Sebastian. Fort Pierce. Jupiter.
lines.show: Ponce Inlet. Cocoa Beach. Sebastian. Fort Pierce. Jupiter.

lines.say: The peak slides about four days later for every degree of latitude you move south.
lines.show: The peak slides about four days later for every degree of latitude you move south.

lines.say: Miami Beach peaks from about October thirteenth to November seventh.
lines.show: Miami Beach peaks from about Oct. 13 to Nov. 7.

lines.say: End to end, that's more than three hundred miles of coast in about seven weeks.
lines.show: End to end, that's more than 300 miles of coast in about seven weeks.

lines.say: Then the mature adults head offshore to spawn.
lines.show: Then the mature adults head offshore to spawn.

lines.say: Pods can stretch hundreds of yards long.
lines.show: Pods can stretch hundreds of yards long.

lines.say: Tarpon, snook, redfish, jack crevalle, bluefish, and sharks follow the bait, and pin it against beaches, jetties, and inlet mouths.
lines.show: Tarpon, snook, redfish, jack crevalle, bluefish and sharks follow the bait, and pin it against beaches, jetties and inlet mouths.

lines.say: That's the blitz.
lines.show: That's the blitz.

lines.say: The classic setup is a falling tide near an inlet, on a northeast wind.
lines.show: The classic setup is a falling tide near an inlet, on a northeast wind.

lines.say: Fish the edges of the pod, not the middle, and be out at first and last light.
lines.show: Fish the edges of the pod, not the middle, and be out at first and last light.

lines.say: If you keep bait, check the current F W C rules first.
lines.show: If you keep bait, check the current FWC rules first.

lines.say: Want to know where the run is today?
lines.show: Want to know where the run is today?

lines.say: Florida Mullet Run dot com scores every beach from live wind, tide, and season data, and maps fresh sightings.
lines.show: floridamulletrun.com scores every beach from live wind, tide and season data, and maps fresh sightings.

lines.say: If you see bait, log it. See you on the beach.
lines.show: If you see bait, log it. See you on the beach.
